user.title: Connect to Hikvision Camera
user.description: Enter the camera's IP address and admin credentials. Digest authentication will be used.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Hikvision Camera
reconfigure.description: Update the camera's IP address or credentials. The new settings must connect to the same physical camera as the original entry.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to camera. Check the IP address and ensure the camera is reachable.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials. Check the username and password.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The settings you entered connect to a different camera than the one being reconfigured. To switch to a different camera, delete this entry and add it again.
